reason: The hypothesis combines the concept of nanoscale phase segregation and domain wall pinning from several sources (P11, P12, P22, P28) with the magnetocaloric effect and exchange energy distribution from the NiFeCoCrPdx HEA studies (P10, P15, P16) and applies this combined mechanism to a new, non-equiatomic FeMnNiGeSi HEA system in a genuinely low-dimensional form (thin films/nanoribbons). None of the passages study this specific alloy or propose a post-deposition treatment to sharpen the magnetocaloric response in such a system, making the integration a synthesis that goes beyond the individual papers.
